Context: 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-

## 5. Procedure Minor Penalties.-  
1. The Government servant should be given a copy of the charge sheet with a statement of imputations of misconduct.
2. He should be given reasonable time and opportunity to submit
3. his defence.
4. On receipt of the defence, the Disciplinary Authority may pass
3. appropriate orders, or may hold an inquiry if-
6. (i)
7. it is of the opinion that such inquiry is necessary, or
8. (ii) the inquiry is mandatory in view of
9. the punishment proposed.
